name: @psi/clinic
description: Programări — the team's scheduling console: server-rendered TSX on Hono, Datastar, Tailwind, psi's admin theme; a PWA; single sign-on through the estate's Authentik

scripts.dev: pnpm i18n && pnpm css && (pnpm css:watch & tsx watch --env-file-if-exists=.env src/server.tsx)
scripts.build: pnpm i18n && pnpm --filter @psi/notify i18n && pnpm css && esbuild src/server.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=hono/jsx --external:hono --external:@hono/node-server --external:zod --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --external:libsql --external:@libsql/* --outfile=dist/server.js
scripts.load: pnpm i18n && pnpm --filter @psi/scheduling-api i18n && pnpm --filter @psi/notify i18n && pnpm css && NODE_ENV=test tsx scripts/load/main.ts
scripts.type-check: pnpm i18n && pnpm --filter @psi/scheduling-api i18n && pnpm --filter @psi/notify i18n && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm i18n && pnpm --filter @psi/scheduling-api i18n && pnpm --filter @psi/notify i18n && pnpm css && vitest run
